rows.Bloom: Orange, yellow undertones. Mild fragrance. Medium, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: mildew resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
